BAKU. ONE CRASH. A BUDGET PROBLEM.

THE PRICE
OF A CRASH

Should Formula 1 stop rich teams
from spending as much as they want?

AZERBAIJAN GP / 26 SEPTEMBER 2026

THE NEWSBAKU / 26 SEP 202602

Three cars out. Parts to replace.

Formula1.com / Azerbaijan GP, 26 September 2026

Colapinto locked up at the Safety Car restart, hit Gasly and collected Norris. All three retired.

What happens to the repair budget?

“all my parts are in the bin now”Lando Norris, quoted by Reuters
26 September 2026

Sources: Formula1.com, 26 Sep 2026; Reuters, 26 Sep 2026. No verified repair invoice in these reports.

THE BUDGET CHOICEILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE03

A repair can cost an upgrade

When a team is close to its spending limit, extra covered repair costs can leave less room for development.

REMAINING CAP HEADROOM$10m
EXTRA COVERED REPAIRS$2m
LEFT FOR DEVELOPMENT$8m

Why can't a rich team simply spend another $2m?

Hypothetical figures, not the Baku repair bill.
The effect depends on unused headroom, spare parts and FIA cost recognition.

Rule basis: FIA 2026 Financial Regulations, Section D, Issue 07. Repairs and R&D compete for covered spending when the cap binds.

REGULATIONTHE FINANCIAL RULES04

Why limit spending?

F1 limits covered performance spending.

COVERED SPENDING

FIA COST CAP

Car development   /   Manufacturing   /   Race operations

from money alone.

Outside this cap: driver pay and the three highest-paid staff.
Spending limits do not guarantee equal performance.

Source: FIA 2026 Financial Regulations, Section D, Issue 07: D1.2, D4 and D5. Conceptual diagram, not to scale.

POSSIBLE, NOT INEVITABLE   Engineering choices and efficiency still matter.

Economic analysis. Context: Formula1.com, “What is the F1 cost cap and why has it gone up?”, 10 Apr 2026. The loop is a mechanism, not measured team data.

THE INTENDED BENEFITSCOMPETITION AND SUSTAINABILITY06

A closer race.
A healthier business

What the cost cap aims to support

COMPETITIVE BALANCE

Less advantage from money alone

Closer competition may help keep fans interested.

FINANCIAL SUSTAINABILITY

Less pressure to outspend rivals

Teams can plan covered spending within a limit.

ILLUSTRATIVE COMPETITION
Engineering choices and efficiency still matter.

The benefits depend on the cap level and enforcement. Teams below the cap, existing facilities and engineering knowledge still matter.

Sources: FIA Financial Regulations, D1.2.2; Formula1.com, 10 Apr 2026. The racing scene illustrates competition, not a measured effect of the cap.

ENTRY BARRIERSA NEW TEAM / AN OLD CHALLENGE07

What does a new team face?

Cadillac joined in 2026. Building a competitive team takes more than a budget.

Cadillac / Baku, 24 September 2026 · Formula1.com
THE NEWS / 24 SEP 2026

Cadillac recruited experienced technical leaders from rival teams.

01 / KNOWLEDGE

People & know-how

Recruit specialists. Build shared experience.

02 / CAPABILITY

Tools & facilities

Develop a capable engineering operation.

03 / APPROVAL

An approved entry

Meet sporting, technical and commercial requirements.

ILLUSTRATIVE FIELD
Community 2026 team models. This is not a performance ranking.

A cap may lower a financial barrier. It does not erase the others.

Sources: Formula1.com, 24 Sep 2026; FIA / Formula 1, 7 Mar 2025. The effect of a cap on entry barriers is economic analysis.

THE ANSWERECONOMICS / CONCLUSION08

Formula 1 should
limit team spending

Spending limits help reduce the advantage from money alone.

A cap cannot erase the knowledge and facilities teams have already built.

Our economic judgment. FIA objectives: competitive balance and long-term financial sustainability.
